When we unfold it for first time, then the half circle drawn at corner will be completed. On second unfolding, there will be two half circles at two opposite corners. For squares, on first unfolding, there will be 2 squares and there will be four squares on second unfolding. Only option 4 has two half circles and 4 squares.
